aboutGame.title: What is Just Dance Decades of Hits?
paragraphs: Just Dance Decades of Hits is Ubisoft Paris' rhythm party game that turns six decades of pop into a single dance floor. Instead of locking into one year of the charts, the setlist moves from 1970s disco through 1980s synth-pop, 1990s girl groups, 2000s boy bands, 2010s festival EDM, and 2020s streaming hits.

It launched on October 13, 2026 for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S, with a Nintendo Switch 2 version following on November 10. Alongside classic song-and-score play, it adds Adventure Mode, a narrative campaign that guides you through themed decade worlds with rewards you cannot earn anywhere else.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Just Dance Decades of Hits.

items.question: What is Just Dance Decades of Hits?
items.answer: Just Dance Decades of Hits is Ubisoft Paris' rhythm party game that packs six decades of music — the 1970s through the 2020s — into one dance floor. It launched on October 13, 2026 for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S, with a Nintendo Switch 2 version following on November 10.

items.question: Which platforms can play Just Dance Decades of Hits?
items.answer: It is available on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S, with the Nintendo Switch 2 release arriving November 10, 2026. There is no PlayStation 4, Xbox One, or PC version in the confirmed lineup.

items.question: Does Just Dance Decades of Hits have a story mode?
items.answer: Yes. Adventure Mode is the series' first narrative campaign and is exclusive to Just Dance Decades of Hits. It walks you through six themed decade worlds with small activities between dances and unlockable rewards tied to your progress.

items.question: How do you score more stars in Just Dance Decades of Hits?
items.answer: Scoring rewards timing, hand position, and continuity. Most setups read the controller in your hand more than your feet, so mirror the coach's arm paths, keep moving through misses, and replay a song to learn its patterns instead of sight-reading new routines.

items.question: What are Gold Moves in Just Dance Decades of Hits?
items.answer: Gold Moves are the one or two split-second poses hidden in every routine. They award a large single payout and give binary feedback — a YEAH if you hit the window, an X if you miss — so converting them can decide your final rank.
